rationale: Provider execution contains one bounded ranking point after the central Model Router has deterministically formed the admitted provider/model set and credential eligibility has been fail-closed filtered. Decision Fabric may rank only that already-eligible execution set using non-secret health, quota-pressure, locality, latency or policy context. Protocol compatibility itself remains deterministic and fail-closed: Decision Fabric must not decide schema loss, protocol admission, security degradation, provider identity or routing. The explicit OpenAI API evidence provider does not add another decision point: it enters this same bounded execution projection only after canonical provider admission, explicit egress policy, Secret Broker credential projection and live current-host evidence.

decision_points.purpose: rank already eligible same-policy-domain provider-execution candidates without expanding the candidate set or observing credential values

project_radar_review.scope: Antigravity-derived provider execution, protocol compatibility, and the explicit OpenAI API evidence provider against current FA3 Model Router, LLM Gateway, Secret Broker, Agent Native and Decision Fabric boundaries
project_radar_review.note: Protocol compatibility remains deterministic; only prefiltered provider-execution ranking may use Decision Fabric.
